senses.gloss:
ITA-9.4.18 mukha-viśodhana मुख-विशोधन
Cleaning the mouth
A step in neonatal resuscitation and general care in which the oral cavity is thoroughly cleaned.

ITA-6.2.6.83 mukhagandhaharaḥ मुखगन्धहरः
Substance removing foul mouth odour

ITA-5.71.15 mukhamaṇḍikāgrahaḥ मुखमण्डिकाग्रहः
Prominent veins, shiny face due to external invisible factors
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: venous prominences on the body; pale complexion of face; polyphagia; urine/cow urine odour; exhausted body; tender palms; tender soles; shiny face; bluish-black venous prominence on abdomen; agitation; dark-coloured veins on abdomen; fever; aversion to food/milk; tired body.

ITA-5.63.1 mukharogaḥ मुखरोगः
Disorders of oral cavity

ITA-9.5.66 mukharogacikitsā मुखरोगचिकित्सा
Management of diseases of oral cavity proper
The treatment of diseases related to the mouth or oral cavity.
